brief: How to launch a brand in 7 days — the no-BS playbook.

slots.title: Launch your brand
slots.ctaText: The no-BS playbook for busy founders

slots.title: Lock Your Strategy
slots.body: Pick a niche, name your vibe, and know exactly who you're talking to. No fancy deck needed—just a one-pager with your mission, audience, and edge. Done is better than perfect here.

slots.title: Design Your Identity
slots.body: Skip the 20-page guideline. Build a scrappy logo, pick two fonts, and lock in three brand colors. Use Canva or Figma templates so you don't get stuck in revision hell.

slots.title: Build Your Homebase
slots.body: You need one killer landing page, not a ten-page website. Write punchy copy, add a waitlist or buy button, and make sure it looks fire on mobile.

slots.title: Batch Your Content
slots.body: Film seven short videos or carousels in one afternoon. Repurpose every clip across Reels, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Consistency beats quality when you're starting from zero.

slots.title: Soft Launch Now
slots.body: Don't wait for perfection. Post, email your list, and tell everyone you know. Real feedback beats imaginary tweaks every single time.

slots.title: Iterate in Public
slots.body: Fix the logo later. Tweak the copy tonight. Launching is a loop, not a line—keep shipping while people are actually watching.

slots.headline: Launch Before You're Ready
slots.body: Grab the free 7-day checklist and build your brand this week. No fluff, just action.
